speaker: Doctor
text:
I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests; to begin our workup, have you noticed any changes in your urine color or stool consistency, such as them appearing dark or pale respectively?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_US

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver_Function_Panel: Bilirubin_Total: 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct: 0.9 mg/dL, Alkaline_Phosphatase: 460 U/L, AST: 75 U/L, ALT: 78 U/L; Abdominal_US: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text: The labs show elevated alkaline phosphatase and direct bilirubin, and the ultrasound confirms thickening and focal dilatation of the bile ducts. Have you recently undergone any surgical procedures or endoscopic interventions, such as ERCP, which might suggest a mechanical obstruction like a stricture?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your history of ulcerative colitis and new findings of bile duct thickening, have you recently started any immunosuppressive medications like azathioprine, or do you notice a yellowing of your skin or eyes?

REQUEST TEST: Antibody_Panel (ANA, AMA, ASMA, ANCA)
REQUEST IMAGES: MRCP

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Antibody_Panel: Anti-Nuclear_Antibody: Negative, Antimitochondrial_Antibodies: Negative; MRCP: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC).

The negative AMA rules out Primary Biliary Cholangitis, and the combination of your history of ulcerative colitis, characteristic "beading" of the bile ducts on MRCP, and cholestatic enzyme elevation confirms PSC.
